name: 192. Responses multi-part assistant output_text maps to chat text (#8196 / PR #8208) (responses-multipart-output-text)
description: Gateway regression for #8196. A Responses-API client (Zed's agent in the report) replays an assistant turn whose text is split across more than one output_text part. ToChatMessages in core/schemas/mux.go maps output_text to text only in its single-part short-circuit; the multi-part switch had no case for it, so the block fell through default: and carried the Responses-only output_text spelling into the chat messages[] Bifrost builds for a chat-only provider. Chat completions defines exactly four content parts (text, image_url, input_audio, file), so the request died with HTTP 422 "unknown variant output_text" naming an index in Bifrost's internal array rather than the client's input[]. The route is /v1/responses against deepseek, whose Responses handler falls back to ChatCompletion via ToChatRequest() - the reporter's own repro, and provider-independent per the issue. The rows read the outbound body with x-bf-send-back-raw-request so they pin the translated spelling rather than one provider's choice of error code. Cases: (1) two output_text parts, the reporter's exact body, red pre-fix; (2) a mixed output_text + input_text turn, also 422 pre-fix, pinning that the mapping is per-part and not a whole-turn special case; (3) a single output_text part, which the short-circuit already handled and which must keep working - a guard against fixing the multi-part path by breaking the collapse. Run with FEATURE=responses-multipart-output-text.

item.name: [EXPECT-200] deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash /v1/responses two output_text parts in one assistant turn translate to chat text - responses-multipart-output-text - #8196

exec: if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object');
pm.test('187.1 the assistant turn reached the provider as chat text parts (pre-fix: HTTP 422 unknown variant output_text) - #8196', function () {
pm.expect(wire.indexOf('output_text'), 'the Responses-only spelling survived into the chat body: ' + wire.slice(0, 600)).to.equal(-1);
for (var i = 0; i < msgs.length; i++) { if (msgs[i] && msgs[i].role === 'assistant') { asst = msgs[i]; break; } }
pm.expect(asst, 'no assistant message in the translated chat body: ' + wire.slice(0, 600)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(asst.content, 'assistant content must stay a 2-part array: ' + JSON.stringify(asst.content)).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(2);
pm.test('187.1 no deserialization error naming the unknown variant - #8196', function () {
pm.expect(txt.indexOf('unknown variant'), 'gateway rejected its own translated body: ' + txt.slice(0, 600)).to.equal(-1);
